effects.label: Afterimage
effects.blurb: The cast leaves frozen copies of itself down the line, and every one of them is still live.

effects.label: Anvilfall
effects.blurb: A machined anvil falls out of nowhere, dishes the floor under itself, and stays there.

effects.label: Arcane Volley
effects.blurb: Seven bolts weave apart down the line and land on one point together.

effects.label: Astral Gate
effects.blurb: A ring gate tears open in the air and obelisks of astral stone climb out through it.

effects.label: Aurora Veil
effects.blurb: Sheets of banded light rise around the circle, ripple for a long while, and climb away.

effects.label: Avalanche
effects.blurb: Snow piles, slumps and finds its angle of repose, collapsing forward over itself.

effects.label: Fulminant Orb
effects.blurb: A caged orb of current walks downrange at walking pace, then opens.

effects.label: Nova Beam
effects.blurb: A charged column of light is let out along the line, and holds there burning.

effects.label: Black Ice
effects.blurb: Meltwater floods the circle and freezes into a mirror that reflects the real room.

effects.label: Hundredfold Flurry
effects.blurb: A flurry of accelerating cuts, each with its own spark, ending in a heavy cross-cut.

effects.label: Crimson Flash
effects.blurb: A point-blank strike: the world drains, then black lightning with red rims tears out of the fist.

effects.label: Flicker Cross
effects.blurb: The fighter strobes out, a hairline of light snaps to the target, and two huge cuts cross there.

effects.label: Moonrend Wave
effects.blurb: A sword swing throws a crescent of energy that carves a burning gash and detonates at the end of the line.

effects.label: Gale Reaper
effects.blurb: A spinning tornado of blades walks down the line and bursts outward at the end.

effects.label: Ghoststep Rend
effects.blurb: A blur of afterimages streaks down the line and ends in one enormous diagonal cut.

effects.label: Hollow Draw
effects.blurb: One flash of a draw, then a web of hanging cuts fills the circle and bursts all at once.

effects.label: Faultbreaker
effects.blurb: A leap and a slam: the floor dishes into a crater and burning fissures race out.

effects.label: Bloomburst
effects.blurb: Flowers unfurl in a wave across the circle, then throw their petals at once.

effects.label: Bone Cage
effects.blurb: Ribs of dry bone punch up around the circle and lay over into a dome.

effects.label: Rolling Ruin
effects.blurb: A boulder rolls down the line gouging a rut, and breaks apart on arrival.

effects.label: Blazing Wheel
effects.blurb: The katana catches fire and the fighter rolls down the line in a rising wheel of brush fire, landing in a crown of flame tongues and a roaring flame tiger.

effects.label: Butterfly Pierce
effects.blurb: Glowing butterflies circle the fighter, then needle-fast thrusts dart down the line and every landing bursts into a flutter of wings.

effects.label: Veiled Mist
effects.blurb: Fog and painted cloud bands roll over the target while phantom cuts flicker between them, until one cross cut tears the mist apart.

effects.label: Crescent Moonfall
effects.blurb: Crescent moons of every size pop into the air over the target and hang under a pale full moon, then all whip round and cut at once.

effects.label: Solar Halo Dance
effects.blurb: A woodblock sun rises behind the caster as they dance two rings of brush fire, then fling the halo down the line into a corona of radiating rays.

effects.label: Thunderclap Step
effects.blurb: One near-instant step leaves a woodblock lightning line and a yellow afterimage past the target; a beat later the delayed strike lands.

effects.label: Tidecutter Form
effects.blurb: Flowing katana cuts trail woodblock water ribbons into a curling crest, then a water dragon uncoils from the blade and dives onto the target.

effects.label: Galecutter Form
effects.blurb: An upward draw throws gale ribbons across the floor that wind into a spiral column of woodblock wind, crescent blades flicking up it until it bursts.

effects.label: Brinelock
effects.blurb: A lane of brine is thrown up in splash crowns and stopped mid-air as clear ice.

effects.label: Broodburst
effects.blurb: A clutch of eggs swells, thins, splits, and lets the floor fill with crawlers.

effects.label: Abyssal Cage
effects.blurb: A cage of soap film closes on the circle, drains, and bursts one bubble at a time.

effects.label: Carapace
effects.blurb: Chitin plates fly in and lock into a dome that closes with no gaps.

effects.label: Chain Arc
effects.blurb: The discharge hops from node to node down the line, lighting one segment at a time.

effects.label: Chronofracture
effects.blurb: Panes of stopped time hang over the circle, hold dead still, and break all at once.

effects.label: Amethyst Verdict
effects.blurb: Amethyst points rise round the target, close on it and shatter.

effects.label: Chains of Penance
effects.blurb: Golden portals open all round the target and chains lash out of them to hold it in the air.

effects.label: Dragonfire Circle
effects.blurb: A dragon circles the zone drawing a ring of fire, then the fire takes everything inside it.

effects.label: Stormheart Gyroscope
effects.blurb: A gyroscope condenses over the circle and strikes everyone inside with lightning.

effects.label: Starbreaker Lance
effects.blurb: Light gathers between the hands and a beam with spiralling streamers blasts into the target.

effects.label: Wildroot Reliquary
effects.blurb: Roots arch over the target, hang it in a ring of runestones and drag it into the earth.

effects.label: Abyssal Maw
effects.blurb: Two water portals tear open; a rock kicks the target up and a great white breaches, bites and dives into the far portal.

effects.label: Astral Tome
effects.blurb: A tome flies to the circle, opens an orrery over it, and its planets fall on everyone inside.

effects.label: Astral Fang
effects.blurb: A wolf of starlight leaps out of a rift, takes the target and carries it into another.

effects.label: Event Horizon
effects.blurb: A raytraced black hole opens over the target: photon ring, Doppler-beamed accretion disc lensed over its shadow, and the world bent around it. Debris spirals in, then it collapses with jets and a flash.

effects.label: Spiral Dominion
effects.blurb: A spiral galaxy of 120,000 GPU stars condenses over the zone, with blue arms, dust lanes and a blazing core. It spins, then its central black hole wakes and swallows the lot in a tightening spiral and a flash.

effects.label: Meteor Storm
effects.blurb: The sky over the zone fills with burning meteors: white-hot heads and long green-blue ion trails raining down on parallel tracks, each striking with a flash, sparks, smoke and a scorch.

effects.label: Nebula Bloom
effects.blurb: Raymarched nebula clouds bloom out of the caster along the line in Halpha pink, OIII teal and gold, cut by dark dust and lit by a cluster of newborn stars that ignites as the bloom completes.

effects.label: Lighthouse Pulsar
effects.blurb: A neutron star spins up inside its glowing magnetosphere, then twin beams ignite along its tilted magnetic axis and sweep the area like a lighthouse, raking a bright spot and afterglow across the ground.

effects.label: Falling Star
effects.blurb: One colossal star falls onto the target behind a real lens flare, wrapped in an atmospheric-entry plasma shell and a long fire trail, then strikes in a white-out that leaves a crater of light with racing cracks and a pillar of light.

effects.label: Stellar Death
effects.blurb: A star swells into a boiling red supergiant, implodes to a blue-white point that bends the light around it, then detonates into an expanding shell of glowing filaments, a shock nebula and lingering gas.

effects.label: Einstein-Rosen Gate
effects.blurb: A seam of light rips through the air and tears wide into a wormhole throat with real parallax, streamers flowing out of it and another sky at the far end, the world bending around its rim.

effects.label: Crimson Tide
effects.blurb: A wave of blood surges down the line, curls, breaks and soaks away.

effects.label: Cyclone
effects.blurb: A vortex touches down on the circle, grinds the floor, and ropes out from the bottom up.

effects.label: Dawnbreak
effects.blurb: Takes hold of the sun and swings it overhead; every shadow on the stage sweeps with it.

effects.label: Wyrm's Breath
effects.blurb: A sustained cone of flame, hollow down the middle, burning a track into the floor.

effects.label: Echo Step
effects.blurb: Three copies of the caster run the line, each replaying what you just did, later and fainter.

effects.label: Eclipse
effects.blurb: The light goes wrong first — colour drains, the key cools — and only then does the black disc open.

effects.label: Black Moon Final Form
effects.blurb: The world drains to black as dark lightning crackles off the caster; one swing becomes a huge pure-black crescent with a white rim that cleaves the whole line.

effects.label: Revving Ripper
effects.blurb: A chainsaw bar grows from the forearm and revs in buzzing pulses, then shoots into the target and grinds in a spray of sparks and comic-red cel splashes.

effects.label: Fivefold Rend
effects.blurb: Five cyan talons slide from the fingers, then a giant energy claw rakes down out of the sky through the target and tears five glowing gouges into the floor.

effects.label: Needle Ray
effects.blurb: A white-hot pinpoint gathers on one fingertip, then a needle-thin beam shoots straight through the target and past it with a hard pierce flash.

effects.label: Blazing Shot
effects.blurb: A bow glyph forms and draws as fire kindles on the arrowhead, then a blazing arrow flies the line trailing flame and detonates in a cel fire blast.

effects.label: Heartstone Ray
effects.blurb: A cartoon heart beats on the chest, then a pink ray of spiralling hearts pours down the line and turns the target to grey stone from the feet up.

effects.label: Demon Mask Cleave
effects.blurb: A horned demon mask, ink-drawn and fringed with flame, rises behind the caster; the swing lunges it forward and the cut at the target is carved in its face.

effects.label: Crackling Palm Barrage
effects.blurb: The palms crackle, then a rapid string of palm explosions walks down the line, alternating hands and growing, each a cel blast with crackle and smoke puffs.

effects.label: Thousand Petal Shred
effects.blurb: Thousands of pink petal-blades pour from the open hand, wrap the target in a spinning ring, collapse into a shredding vortex of cut flashes, then bloom outward.

effects.label: Reaper Wide Sweep
effects.blurb: A pale spectral scythe forms in the hand and reaps almost a full circle around the caster, ghost trails lagging behind the hooked blade, ending in a ring of cuts.

effects.label: Azure Blow
effects.blurb: Blue sparks gather into a hard cobalt flash on the hit.

effects.label: Aegis Dome
effects.blurb: A hexagonal force dome rises over the circle and hums there.

effects.label: Benediction
effects.blurb: A golden sun blooms over the circle and rains pillars of holy light.

effects.label: Blood Lance
effects.blurb: A crimson lance drives into the circle and the ground pulses red.

effects.label: Azure Buster
effects.blurb: A sphere of blue light charges at the hands, then a buster beam tears down the line.

effects.label: Cosmic Mist
effects.blurb: A sphere of cosmic mist detonates in cyan light and drifts apart in starry streaks.

effects.label: Crimson Claw
effects.blurb: A red claw rake tears across the target and leaves burning streaks.

effects.label: Crimson Star
effects.blurb: Red blade rays star out of the target and bloom into a ring of sparks.

effects.label: Crossing Fang
effects.blurb: Two white blade arcs cross on the target and a burst of steel light rips out of the cut.

effects.label: Ember Crescent
effects.blurb: A burning crescent swing splashes sparks across the target.

effects.label: Emerald Ray
effects.blurb: A spiralling green laser fires straight down the line in a single burst.

effects.label: Fireball Blast
effects.blurb: The end of the line blows up in a rolling fireball and a wash of smoke.

effects.label: Blazing Crescent
effects.blurb: A flaming sword arc whirls over the end of the line and bursts into fire wheels.

effects.label: Golden Crash
effects.blurb: A golden shock dome cracks open on the hit, rayed with light.

effects.label: Phantasm Meteor
effects.blurb: A phantasm meteor bursts out of nowhere over the circle in a spray of teal glass.

effects.label: Moon Edge
effects.blurb: A star-white flash, then a full-moon sword ring sweeps around the target.

effects.label: Prism Burst
effects.blurb: A rainbow impact shell bursts on the target, shedding prism sparks.

effects.label: Smash Star
effects.blurb: A white star disc slams open on the hit and a second spark pops off it.

effects.label: Sonic Boom
effects.blurb: The air at the end of the line breaks with a white sonic shock and a ring of dust.

effects.label: Thousand Cuts
effects.blurb: A rake of icy blade lines slices across the target in one beat.

effects.label: Toon Impact
effects.blurb: A cel-shaded impact flower slams open on the target, framed in anime speed lines.

effects.label: Toon Geyser
effects.blurb: A cel-shaded waterspout erupts from the circle and crashes back in a crown splash.

effects.label: Gale Spiral
effects.blurb: Ribbons of wind wind up into a howling blue tornado on the target.

effects.label: Emberflight
effects.blurb: A flock of ember birds streams downrange, then collapses and goes up.

effects.label: Entropy Wave
effects.blurb: A wave of decay crosses the floor — rust, dust, moss and pitting — and then takes it all back.

effects.label: Tidewrought Ring
effects.blurb: A segmented ring is forged flat on the floor, stands upright, and a water rift opens inside it.

effects.label: Electric Aura
effects.blurb: The caster powers up: arcs crawl over the body, coils spin at the feet and the skin charges blue.

effects.label: Fire Aura
effects.blurb: The caster catches fire: flames lick off every limb, orbs circle, and cinders scorch the floor.

effects.label: Arcane Aura
effects.blurb: Violet ribbons wind up around the caster over a dark field while the body glows with runes.

effects.label: Airbending Gale
effects.blurb: Braided wind ribbons carve an S-curve to the target and spin up into a small tornado.

effects.label: Earthbending Wave
effects.blurb: The floor buckles along an arc, plates and boulders heaving up as the wave rolls to the target.

effects.label: Firebending Stream
effects.blurb: A raymarched fireball flies an S-curve to the target, dragging a burning tail, and blows up.

effects.label: Waterbending Whip
effects.blurb: A surging serpent of water swims an S-curve to the target and crashes down in foam.

effects.label: Earthen Spire
effects.blurb: A crust of stone is laid down the line, heaves apart, and a tower climbs out at the end.

effects.label: Electrical Sphere
effects.blurb: A dark chrome orb drops on the point and throws a corona of bolts across a scorched platform.

effects.label: Fire Portal
effects.blurb: A circle of fire is scribed in the air and burns open into a portal ringed with sparks.

effects.label: Kraken Crown
effects.blurb: Tentacles burst from an abyssal pool and hammer the middle of the circle in a rolling beat.

effects.label: Verdant Gate
effects.blurb: Stone blocks fly in and lay an arch, and a swirling green portal floods the opening.

effects.label: Pyre Crown
effects.blurb: A crown of burning crystal blades erupts around the footprint, then burns down to ash.

effects.label: Caustic Bloom
effects.blurb: A pool of live acid opens under a raymarched column of toxic gas.

effects.label: Arborist's Growth
effects.blurb: A chrono-summon of vines and blossom grows, picks its own targets and fires a lance of green light.

effects.label: Astral Void Blast
effects.blurb: A singularity opens, lenses the whole frame around it and eats what it catches.

effects.label: Baleful Cascade
effects.blurb: A crown of spectral blades rises over a mark and throws itself, one blade at a time, at the nearest body.

effects.label: Celestial Rend
effects.blurb: Shards drive into a sigil until it detonates into a thirty-metre column of judgment light.

effects.label: Corrupted Shard
effects.blurb: Corrupted amethyst tears up through a rune; its lens star gathers and fires a beam through the nearest body.

effects.label: Cyber Serpent
effects.blurb: A neon wireframe serpent slithers down the line, its whole trail one vertex-shader ribbon.

effects.label: Sentinel Drone
effects.blurb: A hexacopter prints in, climbs to station and hunts its range ring with tracer bursts, then flies home.

effects.label: Glacial Prison
effects.blurb: A cylinder of striated ice stands on a frozen sheet, freezes everything inside into statues and shatters them.

effects.label: Glacial Shard Storm
effects.blurb: A translucent ice crystal flies nose-first through lit frost vapour, snowflakes and struck-off shards.

effects.label: Monolith Rift
effects.blurb: Brutalist monoliths punch out of the floor with a dust shockwave and ballistic shrapnel.

effects.label: Monowheel Bot
effects.blurb: An armoured one-wheeled sentry prints itself in, balances up and guns down targets in its ring, then stands down.

effects.label: Serpent Tide Phoenix
effects.blurb: A phoenix climbs out of a pyre ringed by fire serpents and hunts: fireballs for the far, talons for the near.

effects.label: Shimmering Flux
effects.blurb: A lattice funnel ploughs point-first down the line behind crimson ribbons, tearing blood off in ligaments.

effects.label: Sumi Tide
effects.blurb: Ink floods the stone, a wall of water stands up, and what it catches is wound under.

effects.label: Toxic Shield
effects.blurb: A sphere of toxic glass laced with crystal spars rises from ruptured stone and turns the bodies inside to glass.

effects.label: Venom Surge
effects.blurb: An amethyst seam tears down the line and opens into a starburst of venom crystal.

effects.label: Void Slash
effects.blurb: An obsidian lance shingled with black glass flies point-first, trailing shadow silks and sparks.

effects.label: Volcanic Ward
effects.blurb: A runed barrier of blood stands over a floor of live lava, beating like a heart.

effects.label: Afterimage Dash
effects.blurb: Shredded, rim-lit afterimages of the fighter string out along the dash line and tear apart strip by strip.

effects.label: Aura Flare
effects.blurb: Charge glyphs collapse onto the chest, a power-up aura flares around the fighter and a burst rings across the floor.

effects.label: Spirit Beam
effects.blurb: Charge in both hands, then a sustained beam with ticking hits and a final blast.

effects.label: Crescent Blade Wave
effects.blurb: A swing throws a crescent of blade energy that flies down the line.

effects.label: Cel Flame Wave
effects.blurb: Cartoon fire tongues with hard colour bands and an ink outline erupt one after another down the line.

effects.label: Crossfang Slash
effects.blurb: Two diagonal slashes that hang in the air and detonate as a cross.

effects.label: Passing Dash Cut
effects.blurb: Dash straight through the target with a low blade; the cut lands a beat later.

effects.label: Detonation Chain
effects.blurb: Explosions walk down the line one after another, each bigger than the last, scorching the floor.

effects.label: Fractal Beam
effects.blurb: A charged orb fires an fBm energy beam whose strands churn down its length, holds with ticking shock rings, then retracts.

effects.label: Thousand-Cut Flurry
effects.blurb: A storm of short cuts from every angle, then an overhead finisher.

effects.label: Axe Heel Drop
effects.blurb: The leg rises overhead and slams down, cracking the ground into a blast.

effects.label: Flash Draw Iaido
effects.blurb: Gather light along the sheathed blade, one instant cut, a delayed slash mark and a huge impact.

effects.label: Nova Burst
effects.blurb: Light gathers on the caster, then a 360-degree nova ring tears across the floor.

effects.label: Piercing Palm
effects.blurb: A short palm push whose shock passes through and bursts out of the far side.

effects.label: Earthsplitter Pound
effects.blurb: Leap and punch the floor; a shockwave races along the ground to the target.

effects.label: Rage Aura
effects.blurb: A flame shell erupts around the fighter, licking upward in hard cel bands, with a refraction shock ring at ignition.

effects.label: Barrage Rush
effects.blurb: A barrage of alternating punches with afterimage fists, then a straight that blasts a shock cone.

effects.label: Crescent Shockwave
effects.blurb: An arm swing throws crescent shock fronts that plough down the line.

effects.label: Slash Storm
effects.blurb: A storm of drawn slashes rips around the target from every angle, then one huge lunge cut finishes it.

effects.label: Whirlwind Spin Slash
effects.blurb: A full spinning slash with a ground ring and a dust burst.

effects.label: Sprite Combo
effects.blurb: Hand-drawn hit bursts march down the line on a beat, then it ends in a big explosion and a ground ring.

effects.label: Rising Dragon Uppercut
effects.blurb: Crouch and drive the fist up through the target, with a skyward shock cone and speed lines.

effects.label: Featherfall
effects.blurb: Feathers come down over the circle — stalling, sideslipping, catching, and gliding.

effects.label: Firewalk
effects.blurb: Footprints ignite in sequence down the line, each throwing a short pillar of flame.

effects.label: Ashen Lash
effects.blurb: A burning lash is thrown down the line and cracks in mid-air where the loop runs off the tip.

effects.label: Strange Attractor
effects.blurb: Tens of thousands of GPU particles pour into orbits around spinning attractor points, braiding into a glowing knot. Port of the three.js compute attractors example.

effects.label: Raytraced Singularity
effects.blurb: A ray-traced black hole opens on the target: lensed, Doppler-beamed accretion disc and a real gravitational warp of the arena behind it. Port of oseiskar/black-hole.

effects.label: Caustic Pool
effects.blurb: A pool of clear rippling water opens on the target, raindrop rings spreading and bright caustics dancing on the floor beneath. Port of martinRenou/threejs-water (after Evan Wallace).

effects.label: Twin Flame Pillar
effects.blurb: Two flame columns roar up on the target: a magenta gradient flame and a stepped white flame. Port of the three.js TSL flames example.

effects.label: Prismatic Fluid
effects.blurb: A real Navier-Stokes dye fluid erupts at the target: swirling prismatic ink with curl, bloom and sunrays. Port of WebGL Fluid Simulation (Pavel Dobryakov).

effects.label: Spiral Galaxy
effects.blurb: A whole spiral galaxy of glowing stars unfurls and rotates over the target, hot core to violet arms. Port of the three.js TSL galaxy example.

effects.label: Hologram Double
effects.blurb: A projector disc beams up a flickering holographic double of the fighter: fresnel glow, scanlines and signal glitches. Port of ektogamat holographic material.

effects.label: Linked Particles
effects.blurb: A cloud of drifting motes that stitch themselves together with glowing filaments as they swirl. Port of the three.js TSL linked particles example.

effects.label: Nebula Domain
effects.blurb: The sky folds shut into a procedural starfield and drifting nebula clouds, a domain sphere around the target. Port of wwwtyro/space-3d.

effects.label: Protoplanet Accretion
effects.blurb: A spinning disc of GPU dust collapses under its own gravity into glowing protoplanets. Port of the three.js GPGPU protoplanet example.

effects.label: Raging Sea
effects.blurb: A disc of open ocean heaves up around the target, big rolling swells with foam-lit crests. Port of the three.js TSL raging sea example.

effects.label: Matrix Sentinels
effects.blurb: A swarm of glowing particles with long ribbon tails snakes down the line like hunting machines. Port of the Codrops Matrix Sentinels (MisterPrada).

effects.label: Eye of the Storm
effects.blurb: A towering emissive noise funnel in dark wisps spins up over a swirling floor ring on the target. Port of the three.js TSL tornado example.

effects.label: Volumetric Inferno
effects.blurb: A raymarched 3D fire simulation billows up from the target, buoyant flame with curling smoke. Port of the three.js volumetric fire simulation example.

effects.label: Vortex Glass Orb
effects.blurb: A glass sphere with a procedural vortex of light spinning inside flies down the line and bursts. Port of the Codrops vortex glass sphere (MisterPrada).

effects.label: Ember Bloom
effects.blurb: A column of painted flame roars up at the point and flings burning embers out in bouncing arcs.

effects.label: Skyfall Strike
effects.blurb: A fractal bolt drops from the sky onto the point, splitting the floor with glowing cracks.

effects.label: Save Point
effects.blurb: A three-layer magic circle draws itself on the floor, a pillar of light rises and a wave of light streaks pours upward.

effects.label: Magma Flare
effects.blurb: A flaring orb of blue magma charges in front of the caster, sparks pouring in, then is hurled down the line and bursts.

effects.label: Gearlock
effects.blurb: A train of involute gears winds up out of the floor, meshes, runs, and seizes.

effects.label: Geyser
effects.blurb: A vent blows a column of water into the air, and the column comes back down as rain.

effects.label: Glacial Crown
effects.blurb: A ring of blades closes around the footprint, stands, and breaks apart.

effects.label: Glyphstorm
effects.blurb: A blizzard of burning marks storms downrange and settles into a lattice.

effects.label: Godspear
effects.blurb: A colonnade of lit air walks down the line, and the room’s own dust burns as it drifts through.

effects.label: Grovecall
effects.blurb: Six trees rise on a wave around the circle and the sun comes through them.

effects.label: Hailwrath
effects.blurb: Freezing air stands over the circle and then it comes down, pocking the floor white.

effects.label: Umbral Mantle
effects.blurb: Ink-black flame tongues with violet and crimson rims lick up round the body and gutter on the floor, staying black even against a bright sky.

effects.label: Sovereign Pressure
effects.blurb: Black-red lightning crawls round the body and the air darkens, then a shockwave of will rolls across the floor, cracking the ground in a ring.

effects.label: Rime Sovereign
effects.blurb: Faceted ice shards with ink outlines orbit the body, a cold mist ring rolls round the feet and the ground frosts over, crystals pushing up through it.

effects.label: Shattering Fist
effects.blurb: A white sphere of cracked air forms round the fist, then the punch shatters the air like glass: the lens cracks, shards fly and a tremor rolls down the line.

effects.label: Boiling Body
effects.blurb: Hard-edged toon steam boils off the body, born red-hot and cooling white, while red heat bands ripple up it and heat rings scroll across the floor.

effects.label: Toon Ascension
effects.blurb: A goofy-godly cartoon transformation: white cel clouds bounce round the caster, a rubber balloon shell squashes and stretches, a sunburst fans out behind and comic pops fly.

effects.label: Plasma Sheath
effects.blurb: A skin of blue plasma hugs the body: white ridge lines crawl over two cel shells, short arcs crackle across them and beads of charge orbit.

effects.label: Arc Cage
effects.blurb: Ink-outlined yellow lightning stands round the fighter as a cage of jagged bars and hoops that re-strikes on twos while sparks shoot straight up.

effects.label: Thunder Halo
effects.blurb: A crown of violet lightning studded with spinning drum-rings hangs over the fighter and hurls bolts down to the floor around them.

effects.label: Hemorrhage
effects.blurb: Hair-thin lances ripple down the line and leave their mist hanging after them.

effects.label: Hive Column
effects.blurb: Comb cells bud outward from a seed, refusing each other, into a tower.

effects.label: Hourglass
effects.blurb: Sand drains into a heap, the zone goes weightless, and then it all falls up.

effects.label: Frost Lance
effects.blurb: A fracture front races out and a field of crystal tears up behind it.

effects.label: Ink Bloom
effects.blurb: A bead of ink opens on the water in branching fingers, wet at the edge and drying behind it.

effects.label: Umbral Pyre
effects.blurb: Inky black flames with violet rims ignite down the line and linger, eating the ground beneath them.

effects.label: Mirror Legion
effects.blurb: Smoke poofs spawn a fan of clones that dash in from every side and land one combined strike.

effects.label: Sealed Abyss Domain
effects.blurb: A black dome seals the zone; inside, the world becomes a void with a staring eye, then it shatters.

effects.label: Coiling Flame Serpent
effects.blurb: A dragon of fire bursts from the hands, sways down the line, coils over the target and dives into a pillar of flame.

effects.label: Great Blaze Exhale
effects.blurb: Three hand signs, then a torrent of toon fire that piles into a rolling fireball big enough to swallow the zone.

effects.label: Twin-Star Erasure
effects.blurb: A pushing red star and a pulling blue star collide into a violet sphere that erases a perfectly clean trench down the line.

effects.label: Heavenly Repulsion
effects.blurb: A held breath, then a perfect sphere of force blasts everything away from the caster and leaves a crater.

effects.label: Gale Shuriken Sphere
effects.blurb: An orb of wind grows spinning blades, is thrown, and bursts into a giant sphere of a thousand micro-cuts.

effects.label: Ascendant Flare
effects.blurb: A layered flame aura climbs the body as rocks lift and the floor cracks, then blows out in a shockwave and burns.

effects.label: Whirling Severance
effects.blurb: A spinning cutting disc formed over the hand skims the line, carving a glowing scar, and detonates.

effects.label: Twin Palm Daybreak
effects.blurb: Orbs in both outstretched palms are clapped together and let out as a blinding yellow-white column.

effects.label: Gathered Sky Sphere
effects.blurb: Light rises off the whole floor into a huge orb overhead, which is brought down as a ballooning dome.

effects.label: Thousand Wren Edge
effects.blurb: Lightning chirps in one hand, then the caster's line becomes a lightning streak that bursts at the end.

effects.label: Gale Spiral Sphere
effects.blurb: A spinning sphere wound up in one palm is driven forward and ground into the floor in a spiral shock.

effects.label: Storm of Fists
effects.blurb: Ki blasts fly from alternating hands and land in a stacked chain of explosions under rolling smoke.

effects.label: Surging Tide Wave
effects.blurb: An orb gathered at the hip is driven to the palms and let out as a wave that trenches the floor to a dome.

effects.label: Locust Tide
effects.blurb: A colony thrown down the line closes into a fist, opens into a wall and lands as a spear.

effects.label: Magma Fount
effects.blurb: A molten pool splits the floor open and throws blobs back into itself.

effects.label: Cinder Fall
effects.blurb: A burning rock is lobbed downrange and tears the floor open where it lands.

effects.label: Mirage
effects.blurb: A double of the caster sprints the line, drawn only in refraction, and is lost as it slows.

effects.label: Mycelial Web
effects.blurb: A fungal mat runs out under the flagstones and shows only as light coming up through the mortar.

effects.label: Borealis
effects.blurb: Night falls and the stars come out, then aurora curtains unfurl overhead, green hems fading to violet and combed into drifting rays, mirrored in the floor and washing the caster in green light.

effects.label: Whiteout Avalanche
effects.blurb: A crown fracture cracks at your feet and a powder avalanche races down the line, its towering head rolling over itself, snow chunks tumbling ahead and a sparkling deposit left behind as it runs out past the target.

effects.label: Firewhirl
effects.blurb: A towering fire tornado spins up on the zone: flame sheets spiral up the vortex into smoke, embers are flung off on the tangent, a scorched spiral burns into the floor and heat haze shimmers round it.

effects.label: Geyser Field
effects.blurb: The zone turns to steaming sinter pools ringed with silica and orange mats, then its geysers blow one after another in streaming columns that rain back down, mist rolling over the field and a rainbow standing in the spray.

effects.label: Supercell
effects.blurb: Storm clouds boil together over the zone and the light goes; branching strikes hammer down with white return strokes that light the clouds from inside, sheet lightning flickers in the deck and rain streaks onto a wet, rippling floor.

effects.label: Rift Quake
effects.blurb: A fault tears down the line from your feet and pulls apart into a deep glowing rift with strata on its walls and magma at the bottom, slabs of ground heaving and tilting away on both lips as dust pours in.

effects.label: Haboob
effects.blurb: A towering wall of dust boils up beyond the target and rolls back down the line, its head tumbling over itself, swallowing the area in amber haze while dust devils spin up inside and sand streaks race along the floor.

effects.label: Tsunami
effects.blurb: The sea mounds up in front of you, runs down the line and curls over a hollow face with spray tearing off the lip, crashes on the target in a whitewater cloud, then surges on over the floor and drains.

effects.label: Caldera Wrath
effects.blurb: The floor ruptures and a lava-veined cone shoulders up and erupts: a roaring lava fountain, glowing bombs arcing out on trails of smoke, an ash plume lit from beneath and lava rivers crawling out across the ground.

effects.label: Crescent Slash
effects.blurb: A flurry of white-hot crescent ribbons whips across the end of the line in alternating diagonals, shedding cyan glints.

effects.label: Ember Gale
effects.blurb: A gale of sparks and embers sweeps down the line, broken into swirling eddies as it cools from yellow to red.

effects.label: Summoning Funnel
effects.blurb: Motes lift off a golden glyph and spiral into a narrowing cyan funnel, then the glyph releases them in a ring burst.

effects.label: Halo Seal
effects.blurb: A golden halo is traced around the circle as blue energy arcs off it, then the seal throws a ring of light skyward.

effects.label: Meteor Shower
effects.blurb: White-hot meteors rain over the circle trailing embers, each one bursting into a fountain of sparks where it lands.

effects.label: Starburst Volley
effects.blurb: Rockets rise from the circle and burst into shells of gold, cyan and violet sparks that rain back down.

effects.label: Nightfall
effects.blurb: A dome of dark closes over the circle from the rim in, and the floor goes out under it.

effects.label: Obsidian Bloom
effects.blurb: Volcanic glass opens out of the floor in curved shells, stands, and goes to flakes.

effects.label: Paper Storm
effects.blurb: A flight of folded cranes runs the line and comes apart into flat sheets of writing.

effects.label: Heavenly Arsenal
effects.blurb: A sky full of radiant swords forms over the circle, rains down point-first, then one colossal blade executes the centre.

effects.label: Prismatic Cathedral
effects.blurb: A prism sigil cracks across the floor and a cathedral of crystal spires erupts out of it, then bursts into light.

effects.label: Astral Chainstorm
effects.blurb: Rune-forged chains whip out of the hand, coil around the target, constrict, and slam it into the floor.

effects.label: Shadow Colossus
effects.blurb: Two colossal shadow arms claw up out of the floor around the circle and crush it between them.

effects.label: Seraphic Deluge
effects.blurb: Gates of light open overhead and a millennium of blades pours down across a wide golden ring.

effects.label: Gravity Crush
effects.blurb: A planetary core forms over the circle, drags the debris of the floor into orbit, and collapses it in one crushing pulse.

effects.label: Megiddo
effects.blurb: A celestial array locks onto the circle and drives column after column of white light into it.

effects.label: Abyssal Moonfall
effects.blurb: A fractured moon assembles in the far sky, storms and splits, then falls onto the circle in a crater of light.

effects.label: Sand Reaper
effects.blurb: A crescent cleaver of carved stone assembles in the hand, spins downrange and bursts into sand and shards.

effects.label: Solar Nova
effects.blurb: A dawnstar is raised over the circle, gathers rings and flares, compresses, and goes nova.

effects.label: Spectral Break
effects.blurb: A prismatic charge compresses in the hand and lets go as a torrent of spectral ribbons that detonates into a shell of light.

effects.label: Tempest Cataclysm
effects.blurb: A storm dragon assembles out of cloud and lightning, wheels over the circle and breathes a thunder beam into it.

effects.label: Thunderlance
effects.blurb: A spear of lightning is forged in a crackling cage, hurled downrange, and overloads into a storm of branches where it lands.

effects.label: Heaven's Verdict
effects.blurb: Storm cloud gathers, precursors feel for the ground, and a single verdict bolt splits the sky and runs out across the floor.

effects.label: Worldrend
effects.blurb: Space tears open in a jagged violet rift, reality shards orbit its throat, and it slams shut in a shockwave.

effects.label: Petrifying Gaze
effects.blurb: Grey facets gather out of the air into a stone column, then run out as sand.

effects.label: Photon Lattice
effects.blurb: A grid of thin beams hangs over the circle; the crossings are bright because two beams add there.

effects.label: Piston Drive
effects.blurb: A battery of hydraulic rams bolts itself into the lane and slams down the line on a cam.

effects.label: Plague Bloom
effects.blurb: A boiling cloud settles over the circle and the floor blisters and bursts beneath it.

effects.label: Prism Lance
effects.blurb: A white lance breaks on a floating prism and finishes as a fan of colour.

effects.label: Pyroclasm
effects.blurb: A dome of ash collapses onto its own centre, then blasts out past the boundary.

effects.label: Acid Boil
effects.blurb: The circle turns to a corrosive pool that boils and pops, spitting acid droplets.

effects.label: Cartoon Blast
effects.blurb: A chain of toon explosions ripples across the circle: spiky impact cards, speed lines and smoke puffs.

effects.label: Gatling Burst
effects.blurb: A rapid-fire burst of toon muzzle flashes and tracers rakes down the line.

effects.label: Azure Nova
effects.blurb: A blue nova cone erupts skyward from the circle and flings smoke-trail rockets out of it.

effects.label: Comet Fountain
effects.blurb: A ribboned comet arcs down the line and bursts into a fountain of bouncing trail sparks.

effects.label: Arcane Vortex
effects.blurb: Motes spiral up a violet vortex over the circle, then it collapses in a spray of sparks.

effects.label: Quench
effects.blurb: White-hot stock is plunged; the vapour blanket collapses and the steam is enormous.

effects.label: Railcoil
effects.blurb: Coils collapse along the barrel and the shot is simply already there, cooling as it dies.

effects.label: Refraction Cascade
effects.blurb: The shot reaches the far end by bouncing off panes that reflect the real room.

effects.label: Resonant Chord
effects.blurb: Rings run down the line and reflect, and the interference stands still where it lands.

effects.label: Rewind
effects.blurb: A gouge tears down the line, stops, and then unhappens — debris, dust and all.

effects.label: Rimewalker
effects.blurb: Sheet ice glazes the floor and peels up off it behind the front.

effects.label: Runic Seal
effects.blurb: A seal writes itself on the floor, catches from the middle out, and goes off.

effects.label: Twin Tide Collision
effects.blurb: Two waves collide mid-line and grind through a swaying clash ball of sparks and lightning until one overwhelms the other.

effects.label: Myriad Flash Step
effects.blurb: The fighter flickers in round the target strike after strike, a shockwave ring bursting at every clash, then drops from above into a slam crater.

effects.label: Hollow Crimson Lance
effects.blurb: A crimson sphere outlined in ink gathers at the fingertip under black lightning, then tears out a wide crimson beam with black edges.

effects.label: Piercing Helix Ray
effects.blurb: Two fingers at the brow wind up a point of light, then fire a needle-thin ray wrapped in a corkscrew that drills clean through the target.

effects.label: Crimson Multiplier
effects.blurb: A red power-multiplier aura that beats like a heart, swelling the flame and slamming rings across the floor under a heat shimmer.

effects.label: Unsealed Heaven Pillar
effects.blurb: Pressure crushes in, then a pillar of power erupts to the sky under a swirling storm, and a dark aura burns on after it collapses.

effects.label: One Earnest Blow
effects.blurb: One plain straight punch: a colossal cone of air pressure cleaves the ground for the whole line and splits the clouds above it.

effects.label: Still Mirror Mantle
effects.blurb: A calm silver aura of thin wisps; afterimages of the fighter flicker in a step aside and vanish in a glint.

effects.label: Burning Slash
effects.blurb: The katana goes up in black-body fire and a combo of burning crescents is opened down the line, ending in a finisher.

effects.label: Flight Blades
effects.blurb: Blades are forged out of the katana in a halo overhead, then loosed one by one down the line.

effects.label: Judgement
effects.blurb: A seal opens over the zone and a giant fist comes down through it.

effects.label: Kick
effects.blurb: A swoosh of the leg and an impact frame: star flash, sparks, a ring across the floor and dust kicked up.

effects.label: Shadows
effects.blurb: Two shadows peel off the caster, run down the line and finish with a slide cut before burning away.

effects.label: Slash Hit
effects.blurb: Steps in and opens it across the waist: a white-hot crescent, hit-stop, and the spray of a body cut in two.

effects.label: Slide Cut
effects.blurb: Skids down the line in a wake of dust and speed lines and opens a rising cut on the way past.

effects.label: Sanguine Pact
effects.blurb: A pool draws itself, sends up a mist column, and beads of blood climb around it until the pact seals.

effects.label: Sawline
effects.blurb: A machined blade buries its rim in the floor and runs the line, throwing sparks off the contact tangent.

effects.label: Phase Shift
effects.blurb: The fighter turns holographic and burns away along an edge-lit noise front, streams down the line as a helical light ribbon and prints back in behind a climbing scan ring.

effects.label: Pulse Blackout
effects.blurb: A core winds up among hovering drones, then detonates into an electric sphere that races to the zone edge while the screen glitches; every device it passes sparks, goes dark and drops.

effects.label: Glitch Rift
effects.blurb: A jagged seam races down the line and reality stops rendering: a debug-grid void, the screen torn by datamosh blocks, pixel-sort smears and RGB split, then the rift snaps wide and slams shut.

effects.label: Schematic Deploy
effects.blurb: A floor projector throws a giant holographic mech schematic with scanlines, flicker and glitch slices, then a scan line prints it into real armour and it lands with a quake.

effects.label: Grid Lock
effects.blurb: Four pylons punch up at the corners of the zone, a laser lattice sweeps it, stands up into a cage that contracts on the centre, then three tilted planes of lasers slice through.

effects.label: Grey Goo
effects.blurb: Twelve thousand nanobots pour from the hand into a churning cloud, build a giant sword that chops the floor, then melt into a giant fist that rockets down the line and slams the target.

effects.label: Orbital Lance
effects.blurb: A reticle paints the target and locks, a hairline guide beam warms up from the sky, then a colossal orbital laser slams down and melts the floor into a cooling molten crater.

effects.label: Plasma Edge
effects.blurb: A plasma blade snaps out of a hilt in the hand with heat shimmer, carves a wide plasma arc around the caster, and the arc tears free as a crescent wave that gashes the floor.

effects.label: Gauss Lance
effects.blurb: Four accelerator coils light in sequence with arcs jumping between them, then a hypersonic slug tears down the line inside a Mach cone, punching vapour rings and flashing through the target.

effects.label: Aegis Hex Dome
effects.blurb: A hex-cell energy dome locks in around the caster from the ground up, takes tracer fire that ripples and cracks its cells, overloads to a strobing red and shatters into tumbling shards.

effects.label: Scrollward
effects.blurb: A ring of scrolls stands up and pays itself out into a wall of writing.

effects.label: Ebon Coffin
effects.blurb: A black box seals the target inside crawling script, spears of black energy drive through it from every side, and it implodes.

effects.label: Brand of the Black Flame
effects.blurb: A seal flares at your neck and black flame-shaped marks crawl over your skin while a dark aura pulses around you.

effects.label: Rubber Tether
effects.blurb: A sticky pink strand whips out, splats onto the target, goes taut, then snaps back like rubber and yanks the target to you.

effects.label: Phantom Barrage
effects.blurb: A spectral fighter rises behind you and hammers the target with dozens of ghost fists, faster and faster, until one giant fist sends it flying.

effects.label: Wire Rig Spin
effects.blurb: Grapple wires bite beyond the target, gas jets fire and you reel along a high arc, then spin over the target in stacked crescent cuts.

effects.label: Hexagon Bulwark
effects.blurb: A flat wall of hex cells snaps up between you and the target; incoming shots burst on it and ripple orange hex rings across the pane.

effects.label: Graviton Tether
effects.blurb: A gravity well opens in your palm, twisted violet strands latch onto the target and haul it to you, rings and grit streaming down the tether.

effects.label: Hall of Thousand Cuts
effects.blurb: The floor drowns crimson and a horned, fanged shrine heaves up behind you, then slashes fill the zone faster and faster until one giant cross-cut.

effects.label: Frost Compass Rose
effects.blurb: A snowflake compass sigil draws on the floor, ice spikes erupt along every compass point racing outward, then everything shatters.

effects.label: Blossom Hands
effects.blurb: Flowers open round the target and cel-shaded arms sprout from them, lunge in and clutch, then crush in a burst of petals.

effects.label: Thousand-Thread Cage
effects.blurb: Glowing strings fall into a dome over the zone, then the cage contracts, cutting grooves through the floor, and slices everything inside.

effects.label: Marked Blink
effects.blurb: A seal-tagged throwing knife bites into the floor down the line, then you blink to it in a single hard yellow streak and flash into being over the mark.

effects.label: Crimson Coil Lances
effects.blurb: Segmented crimson tentacles with glowing joints burst from your back, rear over your shoulders and stab down the line one after another.

effects.label: Stopped Hour
effects.blurb: A colour-inverted sphere bursts out of you and the world freezes grey; only the clock hand moves, ticking round until it lands and time resumes.

effects.label: Eight Trigram Palm Field
effects.blurb: An eight-trigram diagram lights up around you, then palm strikes land in doubling volleys, two, four, eight, up to thirty-two, before one giant double palm.

effects.label: Seal Script
effects.blurb: A column of characters is written top-to-bottom in the air over a wash of ink.

effects.label: Shatterlance
effects.blurb: A single lance assembles in the air, hangs, fires, and breaks apart on arrival.

effects.label: Sheet Lightning
effects.blurb: A fracture buried in cloud strobes, and every real shadow on the stage snaps with it.

effects.label: Shrapnel Bloom
effects.blurb: A canister opens over the circle and throws machined steel that bounces off the floor.

effects.label: Silence
effects.blurb: A sphere of the world stops being rendered. Not black — absent.

effects.label: Singularity
effects.blurb: A gravity well opens over the circle, bends the floor around it, and then inverts.

effects.label: Sinkhole
effects.blurb: The floor cracks, drops away into a funnel and swallows its own lip.

effects.label: Sky Fracture
effects.blurb: The crack shows on the floor first, then the sky splits, then the pressure arrives.

effects.label: Slipstream
effects.blurb: A blade of vacuum opens along the line and the world behind it slides.

effects.label: Voltaic Snare
effects.blurb: A trap of current snaps open on the circle and hauls the air up into a pillar.

effects.label: Solar Lens
effects.blurb: A burning glass hangs over the circle and walks its focus across the floor.

effects.label: Soul Tether
effects.blurb: A chain of ghost-iron links is thrown out, snaps taut, and breaks link by link.

effects.label: Spellbreak
effects.blurb: A bell of arcane glass closes over the zone and breaks — and so does anything standing inside it.

effects.label: Splatterbrand
effects.blurb: A loaded brush is flung down the line: a directional mass, a crown of spikes, and droplets thrown past it.

effects.label: Sporefall
effects.blurb: A slab of spores pours across the floor and glowing motes rise out of it.

effects.label: Starfall
effects.blurb: Cold stars fall out of one point in the sky and open rings across the circle.

effects.label: Stasis Field
effects.blurb: A sphere of stopped time shuts over the circle and everything caught inside it holds.

effects.label: Stone Spine
effects.blurb: Slabs of floor tear loose and heave over on their hinges like river ice.

effects.label: Tempest Wall
effects.blurb: A curtain of rain rises across your heading, restrikes from inside, and drains away.

effects.label: Sumi Stroke
effects.blurb: One enormous brushstroke down the line, which runs out of ink before the end.

effects.label: Sunspear
effects.blurb: A white-fire javelin arcs downrange, bending the world behind it, and opens a sun on the floor.

effects.label: Tectonic Slam
effects.blurb: Five fissures race out to the boundary at different speeds, dust riding each tip.

effects.label: Thornwake
effects.blurb: A barbed bramble tears up along the line and vines thread it into one mass.

effects.label: Storm Lance
effects.blurb: A bundle of lightning filaments snaps out, gutters, and blows out.

effects.label: Thunderclap
effects.blurb: A white flash and a dome, a beat of nothing, and then the pressure front arrives.

effects.label: Tiderush
effects.blurb: A wave runs down the line and throws its own refracted light on the floor ahead of it.

effects.label: Blazing Colossus Fist
effects.blurb: Flame gathers on the knuckles, then a giant fist of hard-banded toon fire is punched down the line, dragging rolling fire billows, and detonates at the end.

effects.label: Thousand-Arm Statue Palm
effects.blurb: A golden many-armed statue with a serene face rises behind the caster and slams one colossal open palm down the line, pressing a palm print into the ground.

effects.label: Glacier Drop
effects.blurb: A giant faceted block of ice crystallises over the zone and drops, shattering into cel shards inside a ring of frost spikes.

effects.label: Thunder Hound Rush
effects.blurb: A hound made of lightning crackles into being, gallops down the line trailing a burnt glowing track, leaps and bites shut in a burst of lightning.

effects.label: Molten Meteor Fist
effects.blurb: A giant fist of black rock veined with glowing magma plunges from the sky onto the zone, splashing lava globs and leaving a molten crater as it cools and crumbles.

effects.label: Soul Pressure Flame Pillar
effects.blurb: Spiritual pressure crushes in, then blasts from the caster to the sky as a narrow flame-shaped pillar with a pressure ring, cracking floor and lifted debris; one slider recolours it.

effects.label: Wraith Armour Colossus
effects.blurb: A translucent armoured giant builds itself round the caster rib by rib, ignites its eyes, raises a spectral blade and cleaves it down the line.

effects.label: Heaven's Wrath Stormhead
effects.blurb: A dark cel thundercloud boils together over the zone and fires a sequence of forked lightning strikes into it, ending on one huge strike at the centre.

effects.label: Torrent
effects.blurb: A cutting jet walks down the line and fans its spray out along the surface it hits.

effects.label: Umbral Spears
effects.blurb: Near-black spears rise out of the shadow, lit only along a violet rim.

effects.label: Undertow
effects.blurb: A whirlpool opens on the circle and winds everything loose down into it.

effects.label: Unmake
effects.blurb: A lane of matter is heaved out of the floor and then stops existing, cube by growing cube.

effects.label: Verdant Lash
effects.blurb: A vine grows down the line, leafing as it goes, then snaps back and sheds.

effects.label: Void Rift
effects.blurb: A slit tears open along the line and the stars behind it move at the wrong rate.

effects.label: Wasp Funnel
effects.blurb: A nest opens on the circle and a funnel of wasps stands out of it, surging as it climbs.

effects.label: Web Line
effects.blurb: A drag-line bites and an orb web spins across the lane, film and all.

effects.label: Wildfire
effects.blurb: Fire spreads across the circle cell by cell, jumping gaps and leaving unburnt islands.
